clues.text: Abram moved his tent to live near the Oaks of Mamre in this town and built an altar there.
Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave of the field at Machpelah, near this town in Canaan.
The spies Moses sent went up through the Negev to this town, where descendants of Anak lived.
Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him this city, because he wholly followed the LORD.
In the hill country of Judah, this town was a city of refuge for the manslayer.
King David reigned over Judah from this city for seven years and six months before ruling in Jerusalem.
Absalom asked King David to let him go to this town to fulfill a vow to the LORD.

taken: Joshua blessed this man and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.
